posts.cap:
Cappadocia, under snow.

The valleys go quiet, the balloons still rise when the wind allows, and every rooftop in Goreme turns white for a few mornings.

Would you see it in winter?

Winter in Cappadocia: a short guide before you go.

Dress for the sunrise, not the afternoon. The snow rarely stays past noon, so go out early. And after the balloons, find a warm cave cafe for a long tea.

Save this for your winter trip.

One city. Two continents.

Ferries, towers and a skyline that changes with the light. Istanbul never looks the same twice.

Istanbul, off the beaten path.

Fener and Balat, with colorful houses by the Golden Horn. Kuzguncuk, wooden houses and quiet streets on the Asian side. Cukurcuma and its antique shops. And Moda, for a seaside walk.

Which one would you visit first? Save this for your trip.

Pasabag Valley, through our guests' eyes.

Shot on a phone, kept forever. Thank you for travelling with us this autumn.

Cappadocia in winter.

Balloons still fly over the snow when the wind allows. Snow-capped Erciyes sits in the background of almost every photo. And dress warm: winter mornings are freezing.

Land of beautiful horses.

That is one old reading of the name Cappadocia, and a ride through the valleys is still one of the best ways to see them.

posts.cap:
Estambul que pocos conocen.

Fener y Balat, con sus casas de colores junto al Cuerno de Oro. Kuzguncuk, casas de madera y calma en el lado asiático. Cukurcuma y sus tiendas de antigüedades. Y Moda, para pasear junto al mar.

¿Cuál visitarías primero? Guárdalo para tu viaje.

No son modelos. Son nuestros viajeros.

Gracias a todos los que recorrieron Capadocia con nosotros esta temporada.

Antes del desayuno.

En Capadocia el día empieza con los globos. Vale la pena poner el despertador.
Despertador a las 5. Vale cada minuto.

Capadocia en invierno.

Los globos también vuelan sobre la nieve, si el viento lo permite. El Erciyes nevado aparece de fondo en casi todas las fotos. Y abríguese bien: las mañanas son muy frías.

Nuestros viajeros. Capadocia, con ellos.

Gracias por compartir estos días con nosotros.

posts.cap:
Ephesus: know before you go.

Arrive when the gates open, before the heat. Wear shoes with grip, the marble is polished by two thousand years of feet. And bring water and a hat, there is very little shade.

Save this for your visit.

Ephesus, through our guests' phones.

Thank you to everyone who walked these streets with us this season.

House of the Virgin Mary.

A quiet hour in the hills above Selcuk, among olive trees and old stone walls.

They came for the ruins, stayed for the stories.

Our guests at the Library of Celsus.

Not snow. Not ice. Pamukkale.

White travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis right above them.
